text: network cograph_network object, matrix, data.frame, igraph object. Matrices inputs auto-converted. title Optional plot title. title_size Title font size. margins Plot margins c(bottom, left, top, right). layout_margin Margin around network layout (proportion viewport). Default 0.15. newpage Logical. Start new graphics page? Default TRUE. background Background color plot. Default "white". layout Layout algorithm. Built-: "circle", "spring", "groups", "grid", "random", "star", "bipartite". igraph (2-letter): "kk" (Kamada-Kawai), "fr" (Fruchterman-Reingold), "drl", "mds", "ni" (nicely), "tr" (tree), etc. Can also pass coordinate matrix igraph layout function directly. theme Theme name: "classic", "dark", "minimal", etc. seed Random seed deterministic layouts. Default 42. Set NULL random. labels Node labels. Can character vector set custom labels. threshold Minimum absolute edge weight display. Edges abs(weight) < threshold hidden. Similar qgraph's threshold. maximum Maximum edge weight width scaling. Weights capped. Similar qgraph's maximum parameter. node_size Node size. node_shape Node shape: "circle", "square", "triangle", "diamond", "ellipse", "heart", "star", "pie", "donut", "cross". node_fill Node fill color. node_border_color Node border color. node_border_width Node border width. node_alpha Node transparency (0-1). label_size Node label text size. label_color Node label text color. label_position Label position: "center", "", "", "left", "right". show_labels Logical. Show node labels? pie_values pie/donut/donut_pie nodes: list matrix values segments. donut single value (0-1), shows proportion filled. pie_colors pie/donut/donut_pie nodes: colors pie segments. pie_border_width Border width pie chart segments. donut_values donut_pie nodes: vector values (0-1) outer ring proportion. donut_border_width Border width donut ring. donut_inner_ratio donut nodes: inner radius ratio (0-1). Default 0.5. donut_bg_color donut nodes: background color unfilled portion. donut_show_value donut nodes: show value center? Default FALSE. donut_value_size donut nodes: font size center value. donut_value_color donut nodes: color center value text. donut_fill Numeric value (0-1) donut fill proportion. simplified API creating donut charts. Can single value vector per node. donut_color Fill color(s) donut ring. Simplified API: single color fill, c(fill, background) . donut_colors Deprecated. Use donut_color instead. donut_shape Base shape donut: "circle", "square", "hexagon", "triangle", "diamond", "pentagon". Default inherits node_shape. donut_value_fontface Font face donut center value: "plain", "bold", "italic", "bold.italic". Default "bold". donut_value_fontfamily Font family donut center value. Default "sans". donut_value_digits Decimal places donut center value. Default 2. donut_value_prefix Text donut center value (e.g., "$"). Default "". donut_value_suffix Text donut center value (e.g., "%"). Default "". donut2_values List values inner donut ring (double donut). donut2_colors List color vectors inner donut ring segments. donut2_inner_ratio Inner radius ratio inner donut ring. Default 0.4. edge_width Edge width. NULL, scales weight using edge_size edge_width_range. edge_size Base edge size weight scaling. NULL (default) uses adaptive sizing based network size: 15 * exp(-n_nodes/90) + 1. Larger values = thicker edges. esize Deprecated. Use edge_size instead. edge_width_range Output width range c(min, max) weight-based scaling. Default c(0.5, 4). Edges scaled fit within range. edge_scale_mode Scaling mode edge weights: "linear" (default), "log" (wide weight ranges), "sqrt" (moderate compression), "rank" (equal visual spacing). edge_cutoff Two-tier cutoff edge width scaling. NULL (default) = auto 75th percentile. 0 = disabled. Positive number = manual threshold. cut Deprecated. Use edge_cutoff instead. edge_width_scale Scale factor edge widths. Values > 1 make edges thicker. edge_color Edge color. edge_alpha Edge transparency (0-1). edge_style Line style: "solid", "dashed", "dotted". curvature Edge curvature amount. arrow_size Size arrow heads. show_arrows Logical. Show arrows? edge_positive_color Color positive edge weights. positive_color Deprecated. Use edge_positive_color instead. edge_negative_color Color negative edge weights. negative_color Deprecated. Use edge_negative_color instead. edge_duplicates handle duplicate edges undirected networks. NULL (default) = stop error listing duplicates. Options: "sum", "mean", "first", "max", "min", custom aggregation function. edge_labels Edge labels. Set NA transparent. edge_label_fontface Font face: "plain", "bold", "italic", "bold.italic". edge_label_border Border style: NULL, "rect", "rounded", "circle". edge_label_border_color Border color label border. edge_label_underline Logical. Underline label text? bidirectional Logical. Show arrows ends edges? loop_rotation Angle radians self-loop direction (default: pi/2 = top). curve_shape Spline tension curved edges (-1 1, default: 0). curve_pivot Pivot position along edge curve control point (0-1, default: 0.5). curves Curve mode: TRUE (default) = single edges straight, reciprocal edges curve ellipse (two opposing curves); FALSE = straight; "force" = curved. node_names Alternative names legend (separate display labels). legend Logical. title: Plot Nestimate Bootstrap Results — splot.net_bootstrap
text: Visualizes net_bootstrap objects Nestimate package. Mirrors splot.tna_bootstrap adapts Nestimate's field layout: weights live $original$weights, directed always TRUE, donut/inits. Plots original tna model nodes colored community membership. original model retrieved attr(x, "tna"), tna::communities() sets automatically. Uses walktrap present x$assignments; otherwise falls back first available algorithm column. Plots original network nodes colored community membership. network retrieved attr(x, "network"), detect_communities() / .wrap_communities() sets automatically. Applies TNA-compatible styling defaults delegating splot(): directed networks get oval layout, coloured nodes, sized arrows; undirected networks get spring layout arrows dashes. parameters can overridden caller. Visualizes boot_glasso objects Nestimate package. Plots partial-correlation network edge inclusion probabilities mapped edge transparency. Plot wtna_mixed object either single overlaid network two separate group panels. Visualizes net_permutation objects Nestimate package. Differs plot_permutation: p_values effect_size already p×p matrices (edge-name parsing needed), directed comes x$x$directed. Network visualization using base R graphics (similar qgraph). Creates network visualization using base R graphics functions (polygon, lines, xspline, etc.) instead grid graphics. provides better performance large networks uses snake_case parameter names soplot() consistency.

what: Donut vs Pie vs Double Donut
title: Plot Nestimate Bootstrap Results — splot.net_bootstrap
text: Three ways show additional data nodes: Donut (donut_fill) Single ring showing proportion (0-1). Ideal completion rates, probabilities, single metric per node. Use donut_color fill color donut_bg_color unfilled portion. Pie (pie_values) Multiple colored segments showing category breakdown. Ideal composition data. Values normalized sum 1. Use pie_colors segment colors. Double Donut (donut2_values) Two concentric rings comparing two metrics per node. Outer ring uses donut_fill/donut_color, inner ring uses donut2_values/donut2_colors.

title: Build MCML from Raw Transition Data — summarize_clusters
text: x Input data. Accepts multiple formats: data.frame /columns Edge list. Columns named /source/src/v1/node1//target/tgt/v2/node2/j auto-detected. Optional weight column (weight/w/value/strength). data.frame without /columns Sequence data. row sequence, columns time steps. Consecutive pairs (t, t+1) become transitions. tna object x$data non-NULL, uses sequence path raw data. Otherwise falls back csum. cograph_network x$data non-NULL, detects edge list vs sequence data. Otherwise falls back csum. cluster_summary Returns -. square numeric matrix Falls back csum. non-square character matrix Treated sequence data. clusters Cluster/group assignments. Accepts: named list Direct mapping. List names = cluster names, values = character vectors node labels. Example: list(= c("N1","N2"), B = c("N3","N4")) data.frame data frame first column contains node names second column contains group/cluster names. Example: data.frame(node = c("N1","N2","N3"), group = c("","","B")) membership vector Character numeric vector. Node names extracted data. Example: c("","","B","B") column name string edge list data.frames, name column containing cluster labels. mapping built unique (node, group) pairs columns. NULL Auto-detect cograph_network$nodes $node_groups (logic csum). method Aggregation method combining edge weights: "sum", "mean", "median", "max", "min", "density", "geomean". Default "sum". type Post-processing: "tna" (row-normalize), "frequency" "raw" (normalization), "cooccurrence" (symmetrize), "semi_markov". Default "tna". directed Logical. Treat directed network? title: Node Vulnerability — vulnerability
text: $$V() = \frac{E_{global} - E_{global \setminus }}{E_{global}}$$ \(E_{global}\) global efficiency full network \(E_{global \setminus }\) global efficiency removing node edges. Global efficiency defined : $$E_{global} = \frac{1}{n(n-1)} \sum_{\neq j} \frac{1}{d(,j)}$$ Nodes high vulnerability critical network's communication efficiency. Removing causes greatest drop global efficiency. Performance note: function computes -pairs shortest paths full graph per node removal, giving O(n) calls shortest-path algorithm. warning issued networks 500 nodes.
